svg.title: cargo binstall urna
svg.desc: urna, end to end: urna setup on an empty machine (scan, plan, the offline embedder payload, the python env, the doctor checks), then urna tui: open a corpus, ask it, read the cited answer, check the install, quit. Steps: 1 · cargo binstall: the crate's release binary, no compile / 2 · the binary on PATH
